meta.description: Editor emotional microcopy for Orivya sanctuary experience

usage.arrivalLines: Show ONE randomly on first entry to new/blank note (per session)
usage.pauseMessages: Show ONE after 8+ sec pause, only if 50+ chars written, once per session
usage.returnMessages: Show instead of arrival line when returning to unfinished note same day
usage.closureMessages: Show briefly (2 sec) when user presses Done

Let your thoughts wander a bit.
No structure needed — just honesty.
This space is yours. Use it however you need.

Write what comes. Edit later, if ever.
This is just for you.
No one's watching. No one's judging.
Begin with what's true.
The first word is always the hardest. Then it flows.
What would you say if no one was listening?
Your thoughts deserve this space.
Settle in. There's no rush.
Write freely. Think out loud.
This moment is already enough.
Let the words find their way.
You're allowed to be uncertain here.
Start messy. Clarity comes later.
What's been waiting to be said?

This thought was holding space for you.

Done for now. Return when ready.

arrivalLine.when: First entry to new or blank note in a session
arrivalLine.alternativeWhen: Use returnMessages if returning to same unfinished note same day

pauseMessage.when: User stops typing for 8+ seconds AND has written 50+ characters
pauseMessage.frequency: Once per writing session (never repeat even if they pause again)
pauseMessage.behavior: Fades in, stays 2.5s, fades out automatically

closureMoment.behavior: Overlay fades in, message animates, then navigates away
